en: A vintage black-and-white postcard with an image of a river surrounded by dense forest. The caption at the top reads, 'Glimån. Stockarne släppas i rännan,' referring to logs being released into a flume or channel, with an additional handwritten note in Swedish. The reverse bears handwritten correspondence, a green Swedish stamp, and an address to a recipient in 'Veristadshamn.' The design and elements indicate early 20th-century Scandinavian postcard style.
